questions.text: Which school room has shelves of books for reading?
questions.discussion: A library is the school room used for reading and books.

questions.text: Students eat lunch in this school place. What is it?
questions.discussion: A school canteen is used for eating or buying food.

questions.text: The teacher writes on the board while students sit at desks. Which room is this?
questions.discussion: Desks and a lesson board are clues for a classroom.

questions.text: A parent needs information from school staff. Which room should the parent visit?
questions.discussion: The office is the room where school staff handle information and administration.

questions.text: Students use this room for worship. Which phrase names it?
questions.discussion: Prayer room is the unit’s name for a room used for worship.

questions.text: Children line up outdoors before class. Which school area fits?
questions.discussion: The schoolyard is an outdoor area at school.

questions.text: Students perform a simple supervised science activity. Which room fits?
questions.discussion: A laboratory is used for supervised science activities.

questions.text: Which school room is used when someone needs the toilet?
questions.discussion: Restroom is the word used in this unit for that room.

questions.text: A sign says “LIBRARY.” Which sentence identifies the room?
questions.discussion: The sign names a library.

questions.text: Complete the question: “What room ___ it?”
questions.discussion: The unit’s question pattern is What room is it?

questions.text: “What room is it?” Which reply gives a room name?
questions.discussion: It is a classroom directly identifies the room.

questions.text: Which question checks whether a picture shows a laboratory?
questions.discussion: Use Is it a ...? to ask whether one room matches a name.

questions.text: “Is it a canteen?” The picture really shows a canteen. Choose the short answer.
questions.discussion: Yes, it is confirms an Is it ...? question.

questions.text: “Is it a restroom?” The picture shows a library. Choose the first part of the reply.
questions.discussion: No, it isn’t rejects the incorrect room guess.

questions.text: Which complete correction matches a library picture after someone guesses “office”?
options: No, I don’t. It is a library.
No, it isn’t. It is a library.
It isn’t a library. It is an office.
questions.answer: No, it isn’t. It is a library.
questions.discussion: Reject the office guess, then identify the library.

questions.text: Why does “Is it the library?” sometimes use the?
options: Every library must always use the.
The speakers mean a particular library at their school.
The word the means many rooms.
questions.answer: The speakers mean a particular library at their school.
questions.discussion: The can point to the particular school room being discussed.

questions.text: The book pattern also uses “Is it a laboratory?” Which word comes before laboratory here?
questions.discussion: Laboratory begins with a consonant sound, so a is suitable.

questions.text: Choose the correct phrase before office.
questions.discussion: Office begins with a vowel sound, so an is used.

questions.text: Which sentence correctly identifies the prayer room?
questions.discussion: The subject, verb, and room phrase are in the correct order.

questions.text: Arrange the words: it / a / Is / classroom?
questions.discussion: An Is it ...? question begins with Is, then it.

questions.text: A card says “schoolyard,” but a friend guesses “canteen.” Which reply corrects the friend?
options: No, it isn’t. It is the canteen.
No, it isn’t. It is the schoolyard.
questions.answer: No, it isn’t. It is the schoolyard.
questions.discussion: The card gives schoolyard, so reject canteen and state the correct place.

questions.text: Read the clues: “It has tables for meals. Students eat here.” What room is it?
questions.discussion: Tables for meals and eating identify the canteen.

questions.text: Read the clues: “There are books. Students read here.” Which question is a sensible guess?
questions.discussion: The clues support a library guess.

questions.text: Read the clues: “Students wash their hands here after using the toilet.” Which room fits?
questions.discussion: The restroom is the room described.

questions.text: The teacher says only, “No, it isn’t.” What do you know?
options: The room is definitely the library.
The room is definitely the canteen.
The first guess is wrong, but the correct room is still unknown.
questions.answer: The first guess is wrong, but the correct room is still unknown.
questions.discussion: A negative short answer rejects the guess without naming another room.

questions.text: A card is hidden. Nita asks “Is it a classroom?” Her friend says “Yes, it is.” What should Nita record?
questions.discussion: The positive reply confirms classroom.

questions.text: Which pair contains two school rooms from Unit 6?
questions.discussion: Both library and laboratory are school-room words in this unit.

questions.text: Which one is an outdoor school area in the Unit 6 list?
questions.discussion: Schoolyard is the outdoor area among these choices.

questions.text: A student says “It is a laboratory,” but the card says “office.” Which correction is accurate?
questions.discussion: The card identifies the room as an office.

questions.text: Which sentence contains both a question and an appropriate answer?
options: Is it the office? — Yes, it is.
Is it the office? — Yes, I do.
What room is it? — No, I don’t.
Is it the office? — On Friday.
questions.answer: Is it the office? — Yes, it is.
questions.discussion: Yes, it is appropriately answers Is it the office?

questions.text: The class list has office, classroom, library, and prayer room. Which word belongs in the same group?
questions.discussion: Canteen is another school room or place from Unit 6.

questions.text: “Is it a laboratory?” “No, it isn’t. It is a classroom.” Which room is correct?
questions.discussion: The second sentence corrects the laboratory guess to classroom.

questions.text: Which question asks for the room’s name rather than checking one guess?
questions.discussion: What room is it? requests the room name.

questions.text: A survey card gives “Made — classroom.” What can you report?
questions.discussion: The card pairs Made with classroom.

questions.text: You hear “It is the prayer room.” Which Yes/No question checks the same information?
questions.discussion: The question repeats the named room as a check.
